description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the MembershipService in the OrangeHRM system. It contains tests for methods such as retrieving a list of memberships, retrieving a membership by ID, deleting memberships, and getting a membership by name. The tests utilize mock objects for dependencies like MembershipDao and load test data from fixture files.

classes.name: MembershipServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the MembershipService functionalities in OrangeHRM, including listing, retrieving, deleting, and querying memberships.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test by creating an instance of MembershipService and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testGetMembershipList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the membership list via the service.

methods.name: testGetMembershipById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single membership by ID.

methods.name: testDeleteMemberships
methods.description: Tests deletion of memberships by their IDs.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a membership by name.
